title: Neartect · Design the near space
description: Neartect designs what a microphone's surroundings do to sound: walls, corners, recesses, and small spaces from centimetres to metres.
socialDescription: Build walls, corners, recesses, and small spaces around a microphone, give each surface a material, and hear how the near environment colours the sound.
